repos_data.description: Easily retargetable and hackable interactive disassembler with IDAPython-compatible plugin API
Agent-first reverse engineering for macOS, Windows and Linux: any ACP agent reads, renames and patches binaries, Android apps and GPU kernel...
Plasma is an interactive disassembler for x86/ARM/MIPS. It can generates indented pseudo-code with colored syntax.

repo_meta_data.description: Capstone disassembly/disassembler framework for ARM, ARM64 (ARMv8), Alpha, BPF, Ethereum VM, HPPA, LoongArch, M68K, M680X, Mips, MOS65XX, PPC, RISC-V(rv32G/rv64G), SH, Sparc, SystemZ, TMS320C64X, TriCore, Webassembly, XCore and X86.
